name: Dappier
summary: Real-time answers from Dappier AI models (live web search, news, stocks) and semantic article recommendations from licensed publisher data models.

api_key.description: a Dappier API key (platform.dappier.com > Settings > Profile > API Keys). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Models are picked by ID from the Dappier Marketplace: AI models start with am_ (real-time search), data models with dm_ (article recommendations). Price depends on the model.
Both calls are reads over POST.
Publisher analytics and the ZeroClick-signed variants are in the API but not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Ask a real-time AI model
endpoints.summary: A written answer from a Dappier AI model, e.g. live web search, news, weather or stock data.

ai_model_id.description: AI model ID from the marketplace, starting am_. am_01j06ytn18ejftedz6dyhz2b15 is the docs' real-time web search model.

query.example: What is the weather in Austin today?

notes: Read over POST. Returns {message}: prose, not a list of sources.

endpoints.name: Get article recommendations
endpoints.summary: Articles from a publisher data model for a query or a page URL: title, summary, URL, site, date, score.

data_model_id.description: Data model ID from the marketplace, starting dm_.

query.description: Natural-language query, keyword, or a URL (the page is analysed and used as the query).

ref.description: Domain where the recommendations will be shown, e.g. dappier.com.

num_articles_ref.description: Minimum articles from the ref domain, default 0.

search_algorithm.description: semantic (default), most_recent, most_recent_semantic, or trending (last 24 hours).

notes: Read over POST. source_url is a tracking link; url is the article itself.
